When: Within ninety (90) calendar days from the date of contract award. Where: American Center, U.S. Consulate General Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Why: To modernize the Center's technological capability with high-end American brand /equivalent hardware that projects a premium, high-tech "American look and

ling flawless technical delivery for public diplomacy programming. Goal: Deploy flexible, multi-modal AV and computing infrastructure that supports formal briefings, large public events, and STEM/makerspace programming. Target Audience: Guests of U.S. Consulate General Chennai, VIP/ executive stakeholders, technical teams, and American Center program attendees & visitors. Primary Objective: Deliver fully tested, IT-cleared, American brand / equivalent technology hardware.
